_note: Costs are in basis points of notional. Round-trip figures already include both legs. Re-verify fee schedules against live account trade history before trusting any net result.

spread_ladder_bps._key: universe_rank by quote volume; quoted spread S, round-trip taker spread cost equals S
spread_ladder_bps._calibration: Override per symbol with Abdi-Ranaldo estimates from trailing 15m OHLCV, excluding signal bars.

slippage._stress_trigger: BTC 15m realized range above its trailing 99th percentile
slippage._tick_note: Add for symbols whose tick size exceeds 1 bp of price (common among low-priced altcoins).
slippage._impact_note: At ~$40 notional market impact is negligible. Do NOT model a square-root impact term.

mexc_perp_api._note: MEXC bills API futures trades at 4/6 bps, overriding the 0-1 bp headline and promotional rates. Non-discountable.
mexc_perp_api._funding_note: Signed against longs. Count actual settlements crossed per zone from the symbol's true funding interval; do not assume 8h across the universe.

binance_spot._leverage_note: Spot only. The 5x paper config is not representable here.

binance_usd_m._note: Family B venue only. Regular-user USD-M schedule. The MEXC row and base_case are not used for this book. A spot-plus-perp hedge also pays binance_spot on the spot leg. Funding is not a flat placeholder: charge the historical funding_rate series.
binance_usd_m._example: The FAQ states a Regular User maker fee is 0.02% and taker fee is 0.05%, charged on position value.
binance_usd_m._bnb_note: 10% discount only when BNB is in the USD-M futures wallet. Otherwise the undiscounted rate applies.

break_even_win_rate._note: Symmetric targets unless R:R stated. Target/stop in bps.

result_scenarios._note: Which cost values produced each published result. Several MEXC taker values existed in the original code; none was silently chosen. Each result keeps the value it was produced with, and the alternative is an explicit, named scenario.

round1_and_smc.alternative_scenario: CostModel.mexc_futures_taker_api(): 6 bps per side, the MEXC API rate in venues.mexc_perp_api. Not used by any published round-1/SMC number. Fees are linear, so it lowers every MEXC net mean by exactly 4 bps per round trip.
round1_and_smc.doc_correction: docs/archive/round1_findings.md said 'MEXC futures taker 0.02%/side'; the code that produced its numbers used 0.04%/side (plus 3 bps slippage per side). An erratum is marked in that file.

family_a.source: src/hawk_research/studies/family_a/simulation.py (round_trip_cost_bps): maker-in 4 bps + taker-out 6 bps (venues.mexc_perp_api) + quoted spread S by rank (spread_ladder_bps) + 0.25*S*time-of-day slippage + 1 bp funding per settlement crossed + 1 bp tick when price < 1

zone_trades.source: venues.mexc_perp_api.taker_fee_bps (6 bps), hardcoded as TAKER_FEE in each script

daily_fade.source: Binance spot taker 10 bps per side + 4 bps top-of-book spread (spread_ladder_bps 1-10)

market_neutral.source: experiments/market_neutral/backtest/pair_costs.py: Binance spot taker 10 bps on both legs + spread S by rank + 0.25*S slippage; funding 0 (spot legs)
market_neutral.family_b: experiments/market_neutral/funding_basis/costs.py: spot leg 10 bps taker, perp leg 5 bps taker (venues.binance_usd_m), spread ladder on both legs, historical funding credited to the short
